title: A Complete part sale with received parts gets the received-parts refusal
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user. That role holds every permission, including Part sales -> Create & Edit and Invoicing & payments -> Create & Edit.
  2. A test customer exists. If not: Customers -> New Customer, enter a name (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair") and save.
  3. A test vendor exists to order parts from. If not: Parts -> Vendors -> New Vendor, enter a Name (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Parts Supply"), then Save & Close.
  4. Start a new part sale today (a sale started before this release handles cores the old way): Parts -> Part Sales -> New Part Sale, then select the customer.
  5. On the Parts tab click Add Part: Description "Brake Pads", Quantity 1, Vendor = the test vendor, Sell Price $290.91. Save the row.
  6. Order and Receive that part (Actions column: Order, then Receive and confirm). Receiving every part takes the sale to Complete. Do not invoice it.
  7. A service work order at Complete for the same customer: Work Orders -> New Work Order, select the customer, add a line, approve the line, then click Complete.
custom_steps:
1. On the Complete part sale holding received parts, open the menu -> Delete Part Sale and read the refusal message.
  2. On the Complete service work order, try to delete it.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The part sale is refused with "Part sale cannot be deleted because it has received parts. Please return or reassign all received parts before deleting." - never with the work order's "Completed ... cannot be deleted" message.
  • The Complete service work order still cannot be deleted (unchanged).
  • Not checkable by hand: a Complete part sale with nothing received can only be produced outside the screens, so the "a Complete part sale deletes" half is left to automation.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667 (Founder Mode Batch #1); story SV-10265 (Read the part sale log, and a menu that stops putting Delete first); Part Sales Update v1 PRD (Confluence 867434569), Story 4; design canvas boards S4_*; read 5 Oct 2026 (specification edited that day). Source-verified 5 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R5: “A part sale can be deleted while it is Complete”
  • S4-R5: “a part sale skips the work order's "Completed ... cannot be deleted" check, so a Complete sale holding received parts is refused with the received-parts message of S4-N3, never with the Completed one”
  • S4-N3: “A part sale holding received parts still cannot be deleted. It is refused with “Part sale cannot be deleted because it has received parts. Please return or reassign all received parts before deleting.” That rule is unchanged; it was simply unreachable behind the Complete check”
  • S4-N4: “A service work order is unchanged. A Complete one still cannot be deleted”
  • S4-R5: “A Complete sale with nothing received is only reachable through the API, and is verified there”

Updated to the 5 October 2026 specification; not yet re-checked against a build.
